description: Replay an agent's tool-call log through the AgentGuard loop and budget guard and decide whether the next call should run. Catches identical and near-repeat loops (same file, URL or command), re-reads of finished items, failing-tool retry streaks and USD or token caps before spend.

errorText.description: Error message when isError; permanent errors (missing binary, 4xx, quota, permission) halt after 1 retry

readOnly.description: Call had no side effects; lets the opt-in completed-read rule apply

resultHash.description: Stable hash of the tool result; repeats with the same hash count as no progress

totalCostUsd.description: Running session spend so far; spend becomes max(spend, total)

name: guard_check_session
